body: This agenda structures the weekly variance review meeting. Print one copy per attendee. The meeting should last 30 minutes and follow the same order each week.
sections.heading: Meeting Details

body: Review last week numbers before discussing causes. Fill each line from the variance dashboard sheet.
sections.heading: Numbers Review

body: For each variance above 1 point, record one suspected cause and one assigned action. Do not list more than three actions per week.
sections.heading: Causes and Actions

body: Confirm par levels and orders for the coming week. Sign and file with the weekly packet.
sections.heading: Par and Orders Sign Off

body: One card per menu item. Attach to the recipe in the kitchen binder. Update whenever a supplier price changes.
sections.heading: Recipe Identity

body: List every ingredient with the unit cost from the most recent invoice. Use consistent units.
sections.heading: Ingredient Lines

body: Record the computed cost and the menu price. File a copy with the manager.
sections.heading: Cost Summary

body: Post this log at each waste station. Staff record every waste event at the time it happens, not at end of shift.
sections.heading: Log Header

body: Record each event on its own line. Be specific about the reason so patterns can be found later.
sections.heading: Waste Entry Lines

body: At end of week, total the log and transfer the total to the variance dashboard.
sections.heading: Weekly Waste Total
